description: Structural validation of two supplied uncompressed FASTQ streams using a bounded Illumina-style non-UMI header profile.

header_policy.index_or_sample: Unsigned decimal at most 65 characters and at most 2147483647, or 1..32 uppercase ACGTN symbols, or two such base tokens separated by +.

pair_policy: Compare ordinal records using the exact seven cluster tokens and the filter/control/index token. Numeric declaration checks accept leading zeros within the token bounds. Equal complete record counts are required; global duplicate detection is not performed.

source_documents.title: bcl2fastq2 Conversion Software v2.20 Software Guide

source_documents.role: Corroborating description of FASTQ and the ASCII Phred+33 range; not authority for the current Illumina header.

rights: Referenced vendor documentation remains copyrighted by its publisher. This profile and its synthetic fixtures are independently written; documentation and third-party fixture bytes are not redistributed.
known_issues: This is a restricted input profile, not support for every FASTQ dialect or Illumina output mode.
Compressed, UMI, interleaved, single-end and wrapped input are unsupported. Decompression and conversions must occur outside this capability.
PHRED33 is a declaration whose compatible alphabet is checked; the encoding's historical origin cannot be established from those bytes.
Run metadata and mate correspondence do not establish biological sample identity, instrument authenticity or preprocessing history.
No trimming, filtering, alignment, calling, interpretation or scientific quality threshold is applied.
Distinct stream objects can share backing storage; full artifact identities do not prove storage independence.
The caller controls blocking-I/O deadlines. Engineering limits bound supplied bytes, records and output, not biological suitability.
